scenarios.title: Edit and save every editable task field
given: Daymark is open with the seeded task list
The task 'Finalize the product roadmap' is visible
when: The user opens that task's editor
The user changes its title, notes, category, priority, and due date
then: The task displays the updated title, notes, category, priority, and due date

scenarios.title: A task cannot be saved without a title
given: An existing task's editor is open
when: The user replaces the title with whitespace
then: A validation message identifies the title requirement
The original task is not overwritten

scenarios.title: Cancel discards task edits
given: An existing task's editor is open
when: The user changes one or more fields
then: The task retains its original values

scenarios.title: Saved task edits persist after reload
given: The user saved changes to an existing task
then: The updated task values remain visible
The browser console has no errors

scenarios.title: Existing completion and deletion actions still work
given: Daymark is open with the seeded task list
when: The user deletes a different task
then: The completed task is marked complete
